plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Squad Six uses your location during outdoor workouts to measure distance and pace. Your exact location is never shown to other people.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Squad Six keeps measuring your outdoor workout while your phone is locked or another app is open. Location is only used during a workout you started.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Squad Six keeps measuring your outdoor workout while your phone is locked or another app is open. Location is only used during a workout you started.

plugins.motionPermission: Squad Six uses motion data during a workout to confirm movement, like steps and cadence.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Squad Six reads workouts and heart rate from Apple Health to verify the workouts you log. It never sells or advertises with this data.
